incidents.title: FunkSec ransomware group builds tools with AI assistance
incidents.targets: Global victims across sectors, 85+ leak-site victims in Dec 2024
incidents.outcome: Rust ransomware, double extortion and DDoS tooling; some claimed leaks recycled from earlier hacktivism.
incidents.confidenceReason: Check Point attributes AI-assisted development from code artifacts; no model named on the report page.
incidents.summary: Check Point reported a fast-rising ransomware group whose encryptor and tooling appear AI-assisted, letting a relatively inexperienced author iterate quickly. Code comments in unusually perfect English were cited as a tell.
incidents.quote: FunkSec operators appear to use AI-assisted malware development which can enable even inexperienced actors to quickly produce and refine advanced tools.

harness.note: AI used as a chatbot/assistant, no agent harness

sources.title: FunkSec: alleged top ransomware group powered by AI
FunkSec ransomware likely created with AI help by an inexperienced developer

incidents.title: Meeten malware campaign uses AI-generated brand content to lure Web3 users to Realst malware
incidents.actor: Operators using the names Meeten, Meetio and Clusee
incidents.targets: Web3 professionals and crypto users on macOS and Windows
incidents.outcome: Web3 users downloaded the Realst stealer.
incidents.confidenceReason: Only the AI Incident Database is cited: actors 'reportedly deployed AI-generated content'. A second-hand relay of Cado's artifact inference.
incidents.summary: Operators of fake meeting-software brands used AI-generated content to build websites, blogs and profiles that lured Web3 users into downloading Realst malware.
incidents.quote: Threat actors, using aliases such as "Meeten," "Meetio," and "Clusee," reportedly deployed AI-generated content to create fake company websites, blogs, and social media profiles, impersonating legitimate businesses in order to trick Web3 professionals and cryptocurrency users into downloading Realst malware.
incidents.singleSourceReason: This operation reaches the ledger only through AI Incident Database's record; the 2026-11-17 sweep found no other publisher.

incidents.title: HTML/Nomani investment-scam campaign uses AI-generated deepfake videos and content (ESET)
incidents.targets: Social-media users lured into investment scams
incidents.outcome: Victims were drawn into fake investment platforms.
incidents.confidenceReason: ESET reports the deepfakes from the campaign it tracked; it reaches us through the AI Incident Database.
incidents.summary: The HTML/Nomani investment-scam campaign used AI-generated deepfake videos and content to mimic legitimate platforms, per ESET's second-half 2024 threat report.
incidents.quote: AI-generated deepfakes were reportedly used in the "HTML/Nomani" phishing campaign to mimic legitimate platforms like booking services and lured victims into investment scams.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only ESET has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep, which AI Incident Database restates.
